name: fix-failing-test
prompt: The test suite fails. Find the bug and fix it so `cargo test` passes. Don't change the tests.

name: rename-across-files
prompt: Rename the function `compute_total` to `order_total` everywhere it's defined or used, including the tests. Make sure everything still builds and the tests pass.
mock_prompt: run: sed -i 's/compute_total/order_total/g' src/lib.rs src/cart.rs src/report.rs tests/totals.rs
check: cargo test --quiet && ! grep -rq compute_total src tests && grep -q 'pub fn order_total' src/lib.rs

name: add-feature
prompt: Add a public function `slugify(text: &str) -> String` to src/lib.rs that lowercases the text, keeps only ASCII letters and digits, and joins the remaining words with single dashes (no leading, trailing or repeated dashes; an empty input gives an empty string). For example "Hello, World!" becomes "hello-world". Add a unit test for it and make sure `cargo test` passes.
mock_prompt: run: printf '%s\n' '' '/// Lowercase ASCII words joined by single dashes.' 'pub fn slugify(text: &str) -> String {' '    text.split(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()).filter(|w| !w.is_empty()).map(|w| w.to_ascii_lowercase()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("-")' '}' >> src/lib.rs
